description: Source code for QuicReceiveControlStream class handling HTTP/3 control stream processing in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicReceiveControlStream
classes.description: Handles HTTP/3 control stream processing in QUIC, including frame validation, error handling, and interaction with the session.

methods.name: OnStreamReset
methods.description: Handles stream reset events, reports error to delegate.

methods.name: OnDataAvailable
methods.description: Processes incoming data frames, decodes input, and manages connection state.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles decoder errors, reports to stream delegate.

methods.name: OnMaxPushIdFrame
methods.description: Validates MAX_PUSH_ID frame.

methods.name: OnGoAwayFrame
methods.description: Processes GOAWAY frame and notifies session.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrameStart
methods.description: Validates SETTINGS frame start.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrame
methods.description: Handles SETTINGS frame and passes to session.

methods.name: OnDataFrameStart
methods.description: Validates DATA frame start.

methods.name: OnDataFramePayload
methods.description: Handles data frame payload, not implemented.

methods.name: OnDataFrameEnd
methods.description: Handles end of data frame, not implemented.

methods.name: OnHeadersFrameStart
methods.description: Validates HEADERS frame start.

methods.name: OnHeadersFramePayload
methods.description: Handles headers frame payload, not implemented.

methods.name: OnHeadersFrameEnd
methods.description: Handles end of headers frame, not implemented.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateFrameStart
methods.description: Validates PRIORITY_UPDATE_REQUEST_STREAM frame start.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateFrame
methods.description: Processes priority update frame, updates session.

methods.name: OnAcceptChFrameStart
methods.description: Validates ACCEPT_CH frame start.

methods.name: OnAcceptChFrame
methods.description: Handles ACCEPT_CH frame.

methods.name: OnWebTransportStreamFrameType
methods.description: Handles WebTransport stream frame type, triggers bug if called.

methods.name: OnUnknownFrameStart
methods.description: Handles unknown frame start, validates frame type.

methods.name: OnUnknownFramePayload
methods.description: Handles unknown frame payload, ignores.

methods.name: OnUnknownFrameEnd
methods.description: Handles end of unknown frame, ignores.

methods.name: ValidateFrameType
methods.description: Validates frame type for control stream, enforces sequence rules.
